player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== COLONEL BLOTTO - Round {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Mafelo a afitileng - Commander Alpha: {alpha_score}, Commander Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mokgwa o sa siamang wa go tsenya tshedimosetso. Dirisa: A:5, B:10, C:5
invalid_move.invalid_field: Leina la tshimo le sa amogelesegang. Dikgwa tse di maleba: {field_names}
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Dikarolo tsotlhe tse di tshwanetseng go abelwa e tshwanetse ya nna dipalo tsa palogotlhe.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: O tshwanetse go alafaka dibiri tse {num_total_units} ka mafela. Ya kgwetho ya gompieno: {current_sum}

outcome.winner_alpha: Commander Alpha a fenya {score_0}-{score_1} ka morago ga {num_rounds} mafelo!
outcome.winner_beta: Commander Beta a fenya {score_1}-{score_0} ka morago ga {num_rounds} mafelo!
outcome.draw: Pati e fela ka {score_0}-{score_1} kgang kgatlhanong ka {num_rounds} mafelo!
outcome.early_winner_alpha: Commander Alpha a fenya {scores_0}-{scores_1} (puso e e tswelelang)!
outcome.early_winner_beta: Commander Beta a fenya {scores_1}-{scores_0} (puso e e tswelelang)!
